concerns.text: The plan applies a paired t‑test with Bonferroni correction to three *metric* comparisons (MSE, MAE, Pearson R). Pearson R is a correlation coefficient, not an error vector, so a paired t‑test on it is statistically invalid. Use a proper test for comparing correlation coefficients (e.g., Fisher‑z transformation) or restrict the paired t‑test to error‑based metrics only.
